purpose: Train the first minimal observation-and-reported-pose-only camera-set model after the independently validated v130 two-direction Krylov capacity gate.
scientific_question: Can an 11,504-parameter permutation-equivariant camera-set model predict the K3 solution and conjugate-direction detector duals on a complete held-out PoolFire trajectory, so the frozen 2A+2A^T shell remains matched to zero-start CGLS K4 under variable camera count and factorized camera errors?
claim_boundary: This is fit-only, post-open development on synthetic straight-ray BOS observations. A fit barrier is not a reconstruction result. Even a positive held-out result would not establish fresh resource speedup, an independent public-data external result, curved-ray validity, experimental BOST validity, broad generalization, an algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.

model.sibling_authorization: only after the primary pose family passes the independently recomputed held-out accuracy gate

outer_training.epoch_shuffle_rule: NumPy PCG64 seeded by fold_seed * 100000 + epoch
outer_training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch only; no validation, early stopping, checkpoint ranking, ensemble or result-dependent retraining
outer_training.loss: equal-weight mean of per-sample squared relative-L2 for the solution dual and conjugate-direction dual over active cameras

fit_barrier.resume_unit: a complete outer fold; an interrupted incomplete fold is retrained from its frozen initialization
fit_barrier.scientific_interpretation: mechanical completion only; no learned reconstruction claim is allowed until a separate scorer and independent validator pass

future_scoring_gate.failure_action: Record the exact negative result and stop this representation; do not run replication seeds or enlarge the network.
